name: Mahou Shoujo Lucifer Ouka
original_name: 魔法少女ルキフェル桜花
source:
These maho shoujos have to hold back the orgasmic energy when the Nightmares exploits it! As magical girls they're sapped and unable to do battle! Suffering in sensitive pulses of shame!?
